title: Shuck It | Stay On 30a – Luxury Beach Homes In 30a Florida
description_expanded: Welcome to 'Shuck It' your dreamy Gulf-front escape where laid-back coastal charm meets elevated beachfront luxury! Perfectly positioned right on the shoreline, this stunning retreat offers breathtaking sea views and direct access to the sugar-white sands and emerald waters of the Gulf. From sunrise coffee on the balcony to unforgettable sunset evenings with the sound of the waves in the background, every moment at Shuck It is designed for pure relaxation and effortless coastal living. Inside, you’ll find a beautifully designed space filled with light, comfort, and modern beach-inspired style. The spacious primary suite features a king bed, creating the perfect private retreat after a day in the sun. The guest bedroom is ideal for families or friends, offering a king bed along with charming built-in twin beds that make the space both fun and functional. Thoughtfully curated décor, cozy furnishings, and upscale finishes throughout the home create a welcoming atmosphere that instantly feels like vacation. Spend your days soaking up the sunshine, walking the shoreline, or exploring the coast with the 2 complimentary bikes included with your stay. Whether you're cruising to nearby shops and restaurants, enjoying lazy beach days, or simply relaxing while watching the waves roll in, Shuck It offers the perfect blend of adventure and tranquility. With unbeatable Gulf-front views, stylish accommodations, and all the comforts of home, Shuck It is more than just a vacation rental it’s the coastal getaway you’ll want to return to year after year! HOME HIGHLIGHTS: – Gulf Front – Private Beach Access – 2 Adult Bikes – Patio with Seating – Smart TVs – Fully Stocked Kitchen – Full Washer Dryer – Beach Gear – 1 Dedicated Parking Spot ACCOMMODATIONS: Sleeps: 6 2 Bedrooms / 2 Baths FIRST FLOOR: Master Bedroom: King Bed with Private Bath Guest Bedroom: (2) Built-In Over Head Twin Bed + King Bed, Shared Bath **WHAT WE OFFER** A STARTER SUPPLY OF PREMIUM AMENITIES: Body Wash | Shampoo | Conditioner | Hand Soap | Toilet Paper | Dish Soap | Dishwasher Pods | Laundry Detergent | Paper Towels | Trash Bags | Dish Sponge | Bath Towels | Bed Linens | Pool Towels WELCOME BUNDLE: Coffee Grounds | Coffee Filters | 2 Keurig Pods | Popcorn | Olive Oil | Fiji Water PARKING There is 1 dedicated parking spot directly in front of the unit with overflow available on a first come first serve basis. Included are 2 bicycles (adult) for your convenience. SEACREST COMMUNITY HIGHLIGHTS: Seacrest is casually upscale, making it easy for guests to find endless relaxation. Turn off your phone and forget about your emails as you explore all that Seacrest has to offer. The area s legendary sugar-white sand and turquoise water are only part of what makes Seacrest a true getaway. Grab a bite to eat and a cup of coffee at Seacrest Sundries, the local grocery store, before spending the day wandering through Seacrest s shops and riding bikes along the Timpoochee Trail. BEACH ACCESS Enjoy private deeded beach access just past the green space toward the back of the home. Big Fish Bike and Beach Rentals is the exclusive provider at your private beach access. HOUSE RULES *Check-In: After 4PM | Check-Out: Before 10AM *Must be 25 years of age to book. Guests under 25 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian that is staying on premises. *No Smoking: Smoking is strictly prohibited including back porch/deck. *No parties or events. *During busier times and due to limited infrastructure, internet connectivity may be affected. No refunds will be given for connection issues no wifi, or slow wifi. *Capacity for 1 vehicle in the parking lot. Additional parking on north end at a first come first serve basis. *Home must remain pet free. IMPORTANT PRIOR TO ARRIVAL All guests will be required to sign a rental agreement, as well as provide a valid ID that matches with the name of the person that made the reservation which includes: 1) a photo of your government issued ID such as a driver s license and 2) a selfie. Other things to note
